identity.title: [v0.92][WP-18C.07a][117.a] Prove Observatory accessibility and responsive UX

values.summary: Bootstrap and review #279 as a bounded Observatory accessibility/responsive proof issue; after terminal dependency validation, bind a FastWork worktree, add deterministic proof and narrow UI fixes if needed, then exact-review, publish, observe CI, and finish.

steps.action: Create the #279 six-card packet and issue-owned preparation validator that proves live issue identity, dependency terminal-cache availability, and scope boundaries.
Obtain a fresh no-context design review and approve only if #279 remains a proof/presentation issue with truthful #280/#281/#282 deferrals.
Bind in a FastWork issue worktree from current main and implement the smallest deterministic accessibility/responsive proof plus any narrowly required Observatory presentation fixes.
Run focused proof, strict relevant checks, diff hygiene, fresh exact-head review, typed publication, required CI, and typed finish.

invariants: Every UX state shown in the browser is representational and tied to Runtime-owned evidence or deterministic fixture input
Keyboard and assistive-technology proof must not depend on hidden network, provider, cloud, credential, or Unity state
Browser changes cannot grant policy authority, synthesize delivery, or mask refusal
#280/#281/#282 and parent coordination records stay out of #279 source/lifecycle ownership
risks: A proof-only issue could uncover defects that belong to #280 or #281 rather than #279
Accessibility assertions could become brittle if they inspect styling implementation instead of user-facing roles/states
Fixture-based proof could overclaim live integrated behavior unless exact candidate revision and non-live boundary are recorded
Responsive checks could miss visual regressions unless paired with explicit width/overflow assertions
stop_conditions: Any required dependency terminal cache is missing, noncanonical, or nonancestral
Design review finds #279 claims Runtime authority or #280/#281/#282 scope
A required proof needs credentials, cloud/public deployment, Unity live host, or paid runner
Implementation would require Runtime contract changes or sibling issue worktree mutation
Focused proof, review, CI, publication, or terminal finish fails
